title: The Nickel Boys
author: Colson Whitehead
summary: Elwood, a studious Black teenager in 1960s Florida, is sent to a brutal reform school because of an unjust arrest. Whitehead draws on a real institution to show what happens to him and his friend Turner.
readIf: you want a short, controlled novel about injustice and its long aftermath.
skipIf: you cannot read depictions of abuse of children and racial violence.
